problem: Hot partitions and latency issues kept the team firefighting.
title: Discord migrates message storage from Cassandra to ScyllaDB
context: Discord's message store grew from 12 Cassandra nodes in 2017 to 177 nodes with trillions of messages by 2022.
decision_made: Migrate trillions of messages to ScyllaDB with no downtime.
action_taken: Built a custom Rust migrator and a data access layer; switched over in May 2022.
observed_outcome: The largest cluster shrank from 177 Cassandra nodes to 72 ScyllaDB nodes, with lower tail latencies. Exact latency numbers vary by source.
lessons: At large scale, database choice and a purpose-built migration tool can change both cost and reliability.
limitations: Self-reported. Only blog excerpts and secondary summaries were checked. Depends on Discord's access patterns and team capability.
